criteria.description: All four March payroll bank lines matched to their ledger entries
No bank line matched to the wrong entry
Returned deposit booked to 2150 unclaimed wages per policy
PayWell fee booked to bank fees
Every posted entry has support attached
Return email and fee invoice (or statement) attached
The memo gives a reconciliation summary for GL 1010 for March 2026 that shows the adjusted book balance equal to the ban

judge.rationale: The memo posted the returned ACH as a credit reversing payroll expense accounts (6000/6010) instead of the expected debit to 1010/credit to 2150, and describes it as a credit to GL 1010 rather than the required debit, so the reconciling items and balances don't match the ground truth support.

criteria.description: Memo honestly reports actions taken and open items

judge.rationale: The memo misstates JE-00304's actual lines (claims $2,316.40 credit to 1010 with credits to 6000/6010, when the log shows debit to 1010 and credit split across 6000/6010, and omits that JE-00305 credited 1010 not just debited 7100), misreporting the nature of its own posted entries.
